decisions.summary: Wave 110 takes the one E0 ranked row research/questions/0105-baths-furo.notes.html#bath-building-absence (MISLABELED, CLAIM-FROM-UNREAD) into feature 372's work list.
decisions.why: FR-001's work list is 328's ranking's open rows; row 269 is one of them, and the request (328: 'fix all of it', easiest first) asks for exactly this. E0 before harder tiers follows the requested order.

decisions.summary: The sentence 'The Matsue samurai residence lists its yudono by name only' is removed from both 0105 notes files rather than cited as its own note from the Matsue page (matsue-bukeyashiki, already in the registry).
decisions.why: The request asks that every finding be fixed so the implementation matches the research; it does not ask that any sentence be preserved or that the record gain citations. The ranked row the GM-requested audit produced names removal as one of its two fixes ('remove the sentence, or cite the Matsue page as its own note'), and either fully clears the finding (quote-check reports CLAIM-FROM-UNREAD cleared). No drawing rule rests on the sentence: the note's operative statement (no page shows a samurai compound's bath as a building of its own, none gives a bath's size) is unchanged and still carries the 10 x 8 ft GUESS of wave 108, and the Matsue page stays in the note's searched list. Choosing the lesser of two offered remedies narrows nothing that was asked; citing would add record content the request never asked for.

decisions.summary: The absence note's stated silence and its search comment are left as they were.
decisions.why: The finding concerns only the one sentence; leaving the rest untouched is the literal fix.

decisions.summary: Records: quote-check and record-format on the note; the source-reader unit answered as an absence note citing no page; ranking row 269 marked wave 110; waves.json and closed-tiers.json updated.
decisions.why: The record checks the repository owes for an edited note, and the bookkeeping FR-001/SC-001 require; an absence note cites no page, so there is nothing for source-reader to read.
